title: Databox vs Geckoboard — Jon Martin
seoTitle: Databox vs Geckoboard for HubSpot Reporting
description: Databox and Geckoboard compared for small teams reporting on HubSpot: entry prices, trials, what each pulls from HubSpot, and how you share dashboards.
dek: Two dashboard tools compared for a small team that wants HubSpot numbers in front of people without exporting reports every week.

blocks.html: This comparison is for a small team that reports out of HubSpot and is choosing between Databox and Geckoboard to put those numbers on a dashboard.
Both connect to HubSpot and both make dashboards. One is built for analysis across many sources; the other is built for a clear, live screen.

Choose Geckoboard if the goal is a live screen of sales or support numbers the whole team can see. Choose Databox if you need custom metrics, several data sources, or several HubSpot portals in one place.
Price is the other big difference: Geckoboard Essentials is from $79 a month, billed annually, while Databox Platform is $399 a month on annual billing ($4,788 a year).

Databox Platform is $399 a month on annual billing ($4,788 a year), or $499 a month on monthly billing. It covers up to 10 users and 30 data sources for one flat price. There's a 14-day trial of the Platform plan with no credit card, and no free plan.

Databox layers dashboards, alerts, and custom metrics on HubSpot, and can merge multiple HubSpot portals and other data sources. Agencies can use a separate plan with unlimited users, priced by account pack at $20 a month per pack (1 account, 5 data sources), billed annually.

Geckoboard Essentials is from $79 a month, billed annually, with 2 dashboards, 1 editor, and 1 screen. Performance is from $319 a month, billed annually. It's free for 14 days, and plans include sharing links and unlimited viewers.

From HubSpot it pulls deals, deal values, activities, contacts, companies, leads, and tickets, across Sales Hub and Service Hub. Geckoboard also says you can share HubSpot dashboards with your team with no HubSpot upgrades required.
If the team needs one screen with five numbers on it, Geckoboard does that with less setup and a lower bill.
If leadership wants HubSpot blended with ad spend, finance, or product data, or you manage more than one portal, Databox is built for that work.
Databox costs several times more at entry, which is hard to justify for a single dashboard.
Geckoboard's Essentials plan limits dashboards, editors, and screens, so a growing team moves up quickly.
List the numbers people ask for and where each one lives. If they all live in HubSpot, start with the simpler tool. If they live in several systems, the multi-source tool earns its price.
Use the trial to build the one dashboard you'd actually show on Monday, not a demo template.
